perks.name: Scoot to Loot
perks.description: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
perks.exact:
Upon scooting:
Pick ups Ammo Bricks within 15 meters. Will also pick up Motes and Crests.
+25 Handling and +25 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.

perks.name: Shoot to Scoot
perks.description: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
perks.exact:
Upon dealing Weapon Damage:
Increases Scoot Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters for 3? seconds.

While scooting:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4)
